description: Program is the schema for the inline YAML program API.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

default.description: default is a value of the appropriate type for the template to use if no value is specified.

type.description: type is the (required) data type for the parameter.

configuration.description:
configuration specifies the Pulumi config inputs to the deployment.
Either type or default is required.

outputs.description: outputs specifies the Pulumi stack outputs of the program and how they are computed from the resources.

packages.description:
packages specifies external packages to be installed before running the program.
This allows declaring parameterized packages and VCS-based components.
Keys are package names, values are package specifications (URLs, versions, etc.).

get.description: A getter function for the resource. Supplying get is mutually exclusive to properties.

id.description: The ID of the resource to import.

state.description:
state contains the known properties (input & output) of the resource. This assists
the provider in figuring out the correct resource.

options.description: options contains all resource options supported by Pulumi.

additionalSecretOutputs.description: additionalSecretOutputs specifies properties that must be encrypted as secrets.

aliases.description:
aliases specifies names that this resource used to have, so that renaming or refactoring
doesn’t replace it.

customTimeouts.description: customTimeouts overrides the default retry/timeout behavior for resource provisioning.

create.description: create is the custom timeout for create operations.

delete.description: delete is the custom timeout for delete operations.

update.description: update is the custom timeout for update operations.

deleteBeforeReplace.description: deleteBeforeReplace overrides the default create-before-delete behavior when replacing.

dependsOn.description: dependsOn adds explicit dependencies in addition to the ones in the dependency graph.

ignoreChanges.description: ignoreChanges declares that changes to certain properties should be ignored when diffing.

import.description: import adopts an existing resource from your cloud account under the control of Pulumi.

parent.description:
parent resource option specifies a parent for a resource. It is used to associate
children with the parents that encapsulate or are responsible for them.

protect.description: protect prevents accidental deletion of a resource.

provider.description: provider resource option sets a provider for the resource.

providers.description: providers resource option sets a map of providers for the resource and its children.

version.description: version specifies a provider plugin version that should be used when operating on a resource.

properties.description: properties contains the primary resource-specific keys and values to initialize the resource state.

type.description: type is the Pulumi type token for this resource.

resources.description: resources declares the Pulumi resources that will be deployed and managed by the program.

variables.description:
variables specifies intermediate values of the program; the values of variables are
expressions that can be re-used.

status.description: ProgramStatus defines the observed state of Program.

artifact.description: Artifact represents the last successful artifact generated by program reconciliation.

digest.description: Digest is the digest of the file in the form of '<algorithm>:<checksum>'.

lastUpdateTime.description:
LastUpdateTime is the timestamp corresponding to the last update of the
Artifact.

metadata.description: Metadata holds upstream information such as OCI annotations.

path.description:
Path is the relative file path of the Artifact. It can be used to locate
the file in the root of the Artifact storage on the local file system of
the controller managing the Source.

revision.description:
Revision is a human-readable identifier traceable in the origin source
system. It can be a Git commit SHA, Git tag, a Helm chart version, etc.

size.description: Size is the number of bytes in the file.

url.description:
URL is the HTTP address of the Artifact as exposed by the controller
managing the Source. It can be used to retrieve the Artifact for
consumption, e.g. by another controller applying the Artifact contents.

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration is the last observed generation of the Program
object.
